E#Unleash a fire nova around you, damaging and knocking back anything caught inside\n- #YELLOW#Dancing Fires: #WHITE#Project your inner fire to all creatures in your line of sight, setting them ablaze\n- #YELLOW#Combust: #WHITE#Disrupt normal burning effects and make them combust at once\n- #YELLOW#Wildfire: #WHITE#Master the Wildfire and pierce even through fire immunities\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "自远古以来，法师们就一直在进行各种元素试验。\n大多数法师满足于使用火系魔法，有些人则进行深入的研究并创造出了焱系魔法。\n其核心是“野火燎原”，这种火焰炽热无比，甚至可以伤害通常免疫火焰的生物。\n\n你掌握了焱系魔法，现在你可以创建一个新的可以学习 #LIGHT_GREEN#焱系技能#WHITE# 的元素法师角色。\n\n技能：\n- #YELLOW# 火焰新星：#WHITE# 对你的四周施放一个火焰新星，造成伤害并击退周围目标。\n- #YELLOW# 无尽之焰：#WHITE# 部分火焰法术会在地面留下燃烧的火焰，灼烧其中的生物。\n- #YELLOW# 净化之焰：#WHITE# 点燃自身与受火焰影响的生物，并有概率移除其状态效果。\n- #YELLOW# 野火燎原：#WHITE# 你对焱系魔法的掌握使你可以对火焰免疫的生物造成伤害。\n"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "25636b255e84e30e199239c5561dc69fd82e9bfa29db7eaf1affdd66aee1de4b",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0552 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/texts/unlock-mage_tempest.lua",
      "source": "Since the dawn of time mages have experimented with the elements.\nWhile most mages are content using the Air school, a few of them took their research deeper and created Storm magic.\nAt its core lies the Tempest, a storm so powerful it can even damage creatures normally immune.\n\nYou have mastered storm magic and can now create new Archmage characters that can learn the #LIGHT_GREEN#Storm talents#WHITE#.\n\nTalents:\n- #YELLOW#Nova: #WHITE#Unleash a lightning nova around you, dazing and damaging creatures caught inside\n- #YELLOW#Shock: #WHITE#Fire a fast bolt of lightning, dazing the target\n- #YELLOW#Hurricane: #WHITE#Call down a Hurricane on any creatures you daze, creating a lightning storm around each of them\n- #YELLOW#Tempest: #WHITE#Master the Tempest and pierce even through lightning immunities\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "自远古以来，法师们就一直在进行各种元素试验。\n大多数法师满足于使用大气系魔法，少数人则深入研究，创造出了风暴魔法。\n其核心是“无尽风暴”，其威力甚至足以伤害通常免疫闪电的生物。\n\n你掌握了风暴系魔法，现在你可以创建一个新的可以学习 #LIGHT_GREEN#风暴系技能#WHITE# 的元素法师角色。\n\n技能：\n- #YELLOW# 闪电新星：#WHITE# 对你的四周施放闪电新星，对周围生物造成闪电伤害并有概率使其眩晕。\n- #YELLOW# 闪电之击：#WHITE# 发射一道快速的闪电箭，眩晕目标。\n- #YELLOW# 飓风：#WHITE# 你的闪电法术使目标眩晕时，有概率在其周围形成闪电风暴。\n- #YELLOW# 无尽风暴：#WHITE# 掌握无尽风暴，甚至能穿透目标的闪电免疫。\n"
    },
    {

      "target": "这只恶心的……东西在地板上迅速地向你爬来。\n它似乎是从“大嘴怪”的消化系统中出来的。"

      "section": "tome-ashes-urhrok/data/talents/corruptions/demonic-pact.lua",
      "source": "Your knowledge of demonic forces grows, allowing you to bind more seeds to you and to summon demons.\n\t\tYou channel your arcane corruption through a demon seed to temporarily summon the corresponding demon for %d turns.\n\t\tSummoned demons can regen their life and resummoning them keeps the life they had when they were last used.\n\t\tIf the demon dies it will not be available for summoning anymore until resurrected.\n\t\tThis spell can summon demons from any seeds available in either your equipment or inventory.\n\n\t\tAs you learn to bind more easily you can also use more seeds:\n\t\tAt level 2 it lets you bind a seed to your first ring.\n\t\tAt level 3 it lets you bind a seed to your shield.\n\t\tAt level 4 it lets you bind a seed to your second ring.\n\t\tAt level 5 it lets you bind a seed to your main body armour.\n\t\t",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你对恶魔力量的理解增长了，你可以将更多种子与装备结合，且可以召唤恶魔。\n\t\t你将奥术腐化之力导入一枚恶魔种子，临时召唤对应的恶魔，持续 %d 回合。\n\t\t召唤出来的恶魔能回复生命，再次召唤时会保留上次召唤结束时的生命值。\n\t\t如果恶魔死亡，将不能再使用同一个种子进行召唤，直到它被复活为止。\n\t\t这一技能可以通过你装备或背包中任何可用的种子召唤恶魔。\n\n\t\t随着你越来越善于结合种子，你也能使用更多种子：\n\t\t技能等级 2 时你能将种子与第一枚戒指结合。\n\t\t技能等级 3 时你能将种子与盾牌结合。\n\t\t技能等级 4 时你能将种子与第二枚戒指结合。\n\t\t技能等级 5 时你能将种子与躯干护甲结合。\n\t\t"
    }
